title: Rocketmoney Metric1 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Renewal calendar events (`calendar:event`), Rocket Money subscriptions (`rocketmoney:subscription`), Stripe invoices (`stripe:invoice`), and Google Workspace licenses (`googleworkspace:license`).
app: Renewal calendar exports, Rocket Money subscriptions, Stripe invoice history, and Google Workspace license data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rocketmoney:metric1 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for rocketmoney metric1 (1) data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for rocketmoney metric1 (1) events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews the smoothed week-long trend in your value from rocketmoney metric1 (1).
